parameters.query: SELECT id, business_name, status, deal_value, updated_at FROM leads WHERE id = $1

UPDATE leads SET
  status = CASE WHEN $2 = 'status' THEN $3 ELSE status END,
  deal_value = CASE WHEN $2 = 'deal_value' THEN $3::text::numeric ELSE deal_value END,
  won_at = CASE WHEN $2 = 'status' AND $3 = 'WON' THEN now() ELSE won_at END,
  updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1 AND ($4 = '' OR updated_at = $4::timestamptz)
RETURNING *
